dialect.detail: IBM DB2 for Windows NT precompiler/runtime interface include file (SQLAPREP copybook), part of IBM DB2 Universal Database SDK. Uses COMP-5 throughout, consistent with IBM DB2 COBOL include files.
evidence: SQLA- prefixed constants matching DB2 precompiler API

purpose.domain_detail: IBM DB2 SQL precompiler and runtime command interface definitions for COBOL programs
purpose.summary: This is an IBM DB2 COBOL include/copybook file (SQLAPREP) that defines global constants, option types, and values for the DB2 SQL precompiler and runtime command interfaces. It provides 77-level constants for all precompiler options such as isolation levels, bind options, date/time formats, and package management settings. It is intended to be copied into COBOL programs that call DB2 precompiler APIs like SQLAINIT.

notable_features: IBM DB2 precompiler option constants (SQLA- prefix)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS blocks (pure definitions)
High comment ratio (~45%) with structured IBM copyright header
PROGRAM-ID value '05' is anomalous - likely a mechanical false positive
verdict.notes: The file has no IDENTIFICATION/ENVIRONMENT/DATA/PROCEDURE divisions detected mechanically, consistent with it being a pure copybook of constant definitions. The 'program_ids: [05]' is almost certainly a false positive from the mechanical parser picking up a numeric value. The source is truncated at 16000 chars but the pattern is clear. This is a standard IBM DB2 SDK include file for COBOL, equivalent to sqlaprep.h for C programs.
